implement.approach: Test first (commit 93a4e8a5, fails on base: no wallet symbols), then implementation (commit 33e2cd40). Core `OfflineWallet` in native/vision-core/Sources: one Keychain generic-password item per owner (`wallet.v1.<ownerId>`) in service com.picklesensei.offline.wallet with kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly, kSecAttrSynchronizable=false, kSecUseDataProtectionKeychain=true; write = SecItemUpdate first, SecItemAdd only when absent, so replace is a single item write after all validation. Envelope {v, payload, tag} where tag = HMAC-SHA256(key, 'pickle-offline-wallet-v1'||0||account||0||payload) with a 32-byte per-installation key in sibling item `integrity-key.v1`; the account in the MAC binds bytes to the owner. load returns nil only when nothing is stored; any unreadable bytes throw tampered / integrity_key_missing / unsupported_version and are only removable via discardCorrupt (clear refuses them). replace/clear are fenced by expectedRevision (0 = absent). Shape rules mirror packages/shared-types offlineAuthorization.ts (canonical owner UUID, identifier charset, compact ES256 JWS with 86-char signature and <=16384 bytes, receipt payload a JSON object <=8192 bytes, caps 8 grants / 64 receipts, no duplicate ids). Grant/receipt payloads are opaque; no tokens are stored. `PickleOfflineWallet` RN module (LocalPods) runs on a serial queue, rejects with code `wallet.<failure>` plus NSError userInfo {failure, status}; Bridge.m exports loadWallet/replaceWallet/clearWallet/discardCorruptWallet. The pod compiles the core via a Sources/Core symlink + podspec line exactly like the other Core files. TS surface apps/mobile/src/native/offlineWallet.ts adds OfflineWalletError, not_configured/bridge_contract failures and strict snapshot parsing.

Implementation (branch devin/pp/w05-01/impl-r2, 3 commits: test 0d446523, test 47a23024, impl 76999e4c): OfflineWallet core (native/vision-core/Sources/OfflineWallet.swift, symlinked into LocalPods/PickleNative/Sources/Core and added to the podspec) stores each owner's grants+receipts as ONE generic-password item in service com.picklesensei.offline.wallet (distinct from the session vault) with kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly re-asserted on every write, kSecAttrSynchronizable=false and kSecUseDataProtectionKeychain; payload {ownerId, revision, grants, receipts} is bound by HMAC-SHA256 over a domain-separated (account || payload) message keyed by a per-device 32-byte integrity key kept in the same service; load verifies tag+owner before returning; replace validates owner (canonical UUID), grant shape (3-segment canonical base64url compact JWS, <=16384 bytes, unique ids), receipt shape (JSON object <=8192 bytes, kind result|unused_ticket_return), capacity (<=8 grants, <=64 receipts) BEFORE any store access, then fences on expectedRevision and performs one whole-wallet update-first SecItemUpdate (SecItemAdd only when absent) so a partially applied wallet cannot exist; clear requires the current revision; corrupt/unsupported/missing-key state throws tampered / unsupported_version / integrity_key_missing and can only be removed through explicit discardCorrupt (never read as an empty wallet). PickleOfflineWallet (RN module on a serial queue) + PickleOfflineWalletBridge.m expose loadWallet/replaceWallet/clearWallet/discardCorruptWallet; each rejection is code wallet.<failure> with failure+OSStatus in userInfo and no grant/receipt content logged. apps/mobile/src/native/offlineWallet.ts is the typed JS side (13 native failure codes + not_configured/bridge_contract, OfflineWalletError, strict snapshot parsing, no `any`). Round-2 deltas vs r1: canonical base64url tail check (matching shared-types), protection class re-asserted on SecItemUpdate, exact 2^53 revision boundary test, `as never` removed from the jest test.
